_readme: The AI models a Development build of GDS Viewer adds under Settings, AI settings, so the key is not typed in every time.
Copy this file to wwwroot/dev-secrets.json and fill in a key. That copy is git-ignored and left out of every publish;
only a Development build (dotnet run) asks for it, and only in a browser no test is driving. A model you already
saved under the same name is left as it is, and one with no key is left out. Never commit the copy with a key in it.
ProviderType is Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or Custom; Custom takes a BaseUrl, such as http://localhost:11434/v1.
